literature.abstract: Salmonella is a significant pathogens of foodborne illness. literature.abstract: Nontyphoidal Salmonella (NTS) is a significant cause of food- and water-transmitted illness in the world, with the burden amplified in low-socioeconomic countries such as India. Here, we aimed at investigating the effects of BRP in combination or not with IPM on human monocytes to assess a possible immunomodulatory action.

literature.title: Comparative efficacies of imipenem, oxacillin and vancomycin for therapy of chronic foreign body infection due to methicillin-susceptible and -resistant Staphylococcus aureus.
literature.abstract: The efficacies of imipenem when directed against methicillin-susceptible (MSSA) and methicillin-resistant (MRSA) strains of Staphylococcus aureus were compared with those of oxacillin and vancomycin in a subcutaneous rat model, using chronically infected tissue cages. At three weeks after inoculation, stable chronic infections were established with average bacterial counts exceeding 10(6) cfu/mL tissue cage fluid for both strains. literature.title: Fosfomycin-daptomycin and other fosfomycin combinations as alternative therapies in experimental foreign-body infection by methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.
literature.abstract: The efficacy of daptomycin, imipenem, or rifampin with fosfomycin was evaluated and compared with that of daptomycin-rifampin in a tissue cage model infection caused by methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). Strain HUSA 304 was used. The study yielded the following results for MICs (in μg/ml): fosfomycin, 4; daptomycin, 1; imipenem, 0.25; and rifampin, 0.03. repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Imipenem 對 MSSA（甲氧西林敏感金黃色葡萄球菌）具高效殺菌活性（結合 PBP1、PBP2、PBP3）。對 MRSA 的直接活性受限（mecA 編碼之 PBP2a 對 β-lactam 親和力低），但 Fosfomycin + Imipenem 聯合方案已有機轉佐證：Fosfomycin 干擾細胞壁前體（UDP-MurNAc）合成，可暫時降低 PBP2a 表達，增強 Imipenem 的殺菌效果（協同作用，synergistic bactericidal activity），多個體外及 Phase 4 臨床研究支持此組合。

嗜酸性粒細胞增多-肌痛症候群（EMS）主要由受污染的 L-色胺酸補充品引起，病理機轉涉及毒性代謝物誘發嗜酸性粒細胞浸潤及 TGF-β 介導纖維化。Imipenem 為抗菌藥物，無已知嗜酸性粒細胞調節或抗纖維化機轉。值得注意的是，β-lactam 抗生素（包含 imipenem）本身偶可誘發藥物性嗜酸性粒細胞增多症（drug-induced eosinophilia），此與治療 EMS 目標相悖，使用可能加重病情。此為知識圖譜預測的典型偽關聯。
